title: Human dual-reviewer screening workspace + conflict adjudication + append-only audit (no AI yet)
context: Before the AI screening assist (task 011) is introduced, the tool must establish the human-only baseline workflow: two independent reviewers each screen every record (title/abstract then full text), disagreements are flagged for adjudication by a third reviewer or consensus, and every disposition is recorded with the human actor, reason, and timestamp in an append-only audit trail. This establishes both the methodological gold standard and the audit-trail data model that the AI assist will later plug into. No AI suggestions exist at this stage. Depends on 003 (policy layer, which enforces that every disposition has a human actor), 004 (provenance store), and 007 (ingest, to have records to screen).
objective: Implement the human dual-reviewer screening workspace in @hee-lee-oss/sra-core and @hee-lee-oss/sra-cli: two independent reviewers each record include/exclude/uncertain dispositions with a reason for each record (title/abstract stage, then full-text stage); conflicts (disagreements between reviewers) are flagged and routed to adjudication; every disposition is written to the append-only audit log with the human actor, disposition, reason, stage (title-abstract/full-text), and timestamp. No AI is involved at this stage.
acceptanceCriteria: Two independent reviewers can each record include/exclude/uncertain dispositions with a mandatory reason for every record at title/abstract stage; a separate full-text screening stage follows for records not excluded at title/abstract
Conflicts (records where two reviewers disagree) are automatically detected and routed to a third-reviewer adjudication step; the adjudicator records the final disposition with a reason

Every disposition event (reviewer id, stage, disposition, reason, timestamp) is written to the append-only audit log via the provenance store (task 004); no disposition can be recorded without a human actor field (policy layer invariant from task 003)
The CLI (or local UI) exposes commands to: assign records to reviewers, record a disposition, list conflicts, adjudicate a conflict, and export the full screening audit log

Tests cover: dual-reviewer disposition recording, conflict detection, adjudication workflow, audit-log append-only writes, and policy-layer rejection of a disposition lacking a human actor; all run in CI
pnpm build && pnpm test pass with screening workspace tests green
output: A merged PR adding the human dual-reviewer screening workspace (title/abstract + full-text stages, conflict adjudication, append-only audit) to @hee-lee-oss/sra-core and @hee-lee-oss/sra-cli, with no AI involvement and a full test suite.
